trigger.fact: R12 fresh route/custody admission is PASS, but current owners do not define enough concrete pre-genesis material identity to assemble an owner-valid concrete-security phase-U register request without guessing credentialProvisioningId and release-trust projection semantics.

observedExistingSeams.register: D0027 register requires credentialProvisioningId, packageManifestDigest, packageTrustSubjectDigest, trustStateDigest, trustSubjects and, for D0039 concrete security, an exact RSA-3072 credential public verifier before it atomically allocates the next pending generations.
observedExistingSeams.predecessor: The authoritative predecessor view exposes every generation high-water needed to project the one next candidate from an UNREGISTERED route.
observedExistingSeams.keystore: TermuxAndroidKeyStoreCredential already derives a deterministic route/generation-bound alias, provisions RSA-3072 idempotently by exact alias readback, returns only the public verifier/credential reference, and supports exact-alias deletion.
observedExistingSeams.q3: Historical physical Q3 proved the Android/Termux/keystore path with credentialMutation=not_requested; it did not leave a current R12 credential.
observedExistingSeams.releaseTrust: D0039 already selects an offline route release root plus root-signed tdev.release-delegation.v1 delegated signers; the existing verifier enforces signer disposition and exact package subject authorization.
observedExistingSeams.missing: No production owner derives credentialProvisioningId or projects a verified release delegation into D0027 trustSubjects/packageTrustSubjectDigest/trustStateDigest. Historical tests/live probes used synthetic values and are not authority for the missing rule.

sdd.reason: The missing stable identifier/digest/trust projection plus pre-dispatch orphan/reconciliation lifecycle is independently decidable security/identity meaning. Guessing it inside D0039 phase-U would violate SDD; extending D0039 again would also recreate the revision-churn boundary R12 explicitly stopped for independently reusable lifecycle semantics.

decision.scope: pre-genesis material identity, projection, preparation and reconciliation only
decision.credentialProvisioningId: cp1.<64 lowercase hex>, where the suffix is typedDigest(profile, exact normalized preparation record) without the sha256: prefix
decision.credentialAlias: reuse the existing tdev Agent keystore alias record bound to agentId/routeGeneration/projected installationGeneration/projected credentialGeneration
decision.credentialAuthority: prepared AndroidKeyStore material is a non-authoritative candidate until D0027 commits the exact phase-U register transaction
decision.trustSubjects: map every root-verified normalized release-delegation signer keyId to its exact active/retired/revoked disposition
decision.packageTrustSubjectDigest: the exact verified release-statement signerKeyId; it must be active and authorized for the exact package release subject under the same delegation
decision.trustStateDigest: typedDigest(tdev.release-delegation.v1, normalized root-verified release delegation), exactly the SHA-256 identity of the same domain-NUL-canonical-record bytes authenticated by the release-root signature
decision.reconciliation: fresh authoritative route readback must still match the preparation predecessor/high-waters before dispatch; ambiguous register effects are reconciled by exact route/pending identity before any replay, remint or cleanup

preservedOwners.d0039: provider/Q4/phase-U/phase-P orchestration and concrete deployment realization

rejectedAlternatives.syntheticTrustDigest: digest({trustSubjects}) is not the root-authenticated release-delegation identity and has no current owner authorization
rejectedAlternatives.syntheticReleaseKeyDigest: historical digest({releaseKey: ...}) live-probe values are evidence artifacts, not product trust-state authority
rejectedAlternatives.randomProvisioningId: would not encode stable predecessor/candidate correlation and complicates retry/orphan reconciliation
rejectedAlternatives.serverGeneratedCredential: D0039 selected the supported Termux:API AndroidKeyStore RSA-3072 credential; a server-side substitute violates that realization
rejectedAlternatives.phaseUFirst: register cannot safely precede candidate public-verifier preparation because concrete-security admission requires that verifier in the request

next: Route accepted D0041@r1 for source implementation and qualification. Keep D0039@r12 implementing but remove it from the runnable frontier until D0041 proves owner-valid pre-genesis material assembly; phase-U/P remain forbidden meanwhile.
